description: Sentry CLI (`sentry-cli`): release deletion, release bookkeeping and events (writes), commands that it runs, and read commands.

rules.note: `releases delete` removes a release with its files and deploy data.

safe.note: The configuration check (it does not print the token), listings of releases, projects, organizations, repositories, deploys, and files, release details, and a proposed version name.

writes.note: Release bookkeeping for the error reports of the project (a new or finalized release, its commits, a deploy record, and source map or debug file uploads) and new events add data to Sentry. It is a remote write, so it is not known safe (dev round 3). A release can be deleted.
